summary.headline: Ajmera Realty Q1 FY27 revenue rose 23% YoY to INR320 crores, PAT up 14% to INR45 crores, debt cut to INR680 crores.
summary.overview: Revenue for Q1 FY27 was about INR320 crores, up 23% YoY from INR265 crores, with EBITDA of INR94 crores (about 29% margin) and PAT of INR45 crores (14% margin). Ajmera Solis entered revenue recognition for the first time this quarter. Debt fell by INR57 crores to INR680 crores, taking debt-equity to 0.47x. Sales value was INR146 crores against collections of about INR173 crores, and INR89 crores was received from a property asset monetisation against a INR330 crores target.

segments.name: Residential (Mumbai)
segments.commentary: Manhattan 1 ~93% sold; Greenfinity A&B 94% sold, nearing OC; Vihara Bhandup 81% sold; Solis 86% absorbed and first to enter revenue recognition this quarter.

segments.name: Commercial (Bandra 33Fifteen)
segments.commentary: 19% of inventory sold; piling and shoring in progress; management aims to speed up execution.

segments.name: Luxury collective (Ajmera One, Versova)
segments.commentary: 3% of inventory sold as of the call date; excavation stage, subdued sales expected this year.

segments.name: Bangalore
segments.commentary: Iris 90% sold, finishing work toward OC; Marina 69% sold, second slab in progress.

segments.name: Wadala (Manhattan 2 and others)
segments.commentary: Over 50% of inventory sold, excavation in progress; boutique office Phase 1 part of ~INR18,000 crore Wadala GDV.

guidance_outlook: Revenue visibility of INR3,846 crores (INR1,661 crores committed sales plus INR2,185 crores unsold inventory), rising to INR10,000-plus crores with the upcoming launch pipeline of about INR6,500 crores.

FY27 launch pipeline of about INR3,000 crores (call mentions INR6,500 crores for launches in another part of the call); Wadala boutique office launch in a single phase of about INR3,600 crores, targeted for Q3.
Estimated cash flow potential, pre-tax and post-debt, from ongoing projects, upcoming projects and other revenue of about INR3,380 crores over project life cycles.
Remaining INR241 crores of the INR330 crores asset monetisation target; a further stake sale in a JV was signed in early July 2026 and will be reported in Q2.

Debt-equity target of 1x by FY27-end was reiterated, but management said Q1 and Q2 may see higher working-capital borrowing before deleveraging resumes. Finance cost is expected to normalise to about INR20 crores from next quarter.
capex_capacity: Wadala: ~1 million sq ft of additional FSI added, lifting GDV by about INR3,000 crores; office launch scaled from 4-5 lakh sq ft to 8-8.5 lakh sq ft.

Kanjurmarg 7-acre land: land conversion targeted within 2-3 months, ahead of the December deadline; strategic tie-up talks ongoing (mix of outright sale and JV) but to conclude only after conversion; the single deal is expected to be one transaction.
Kanjurmarg 55-acre project: master planning frozen, technical evaluation in Phase 2, infrastructure work to start soon; launch targeted in FY28.
Pune project timeline moved from Q1 to Q4 FY27 and Borivali from Q3 to Q4 FY27; launches to be timed at plinth level for better pricing.

Bangalore SV Concrete project removed from pipeline and replaced by Whitefield (INR389 crores GDV, asset-light, Q4 FY27 target) against a INR1,800 crore BD guidance; a further ~INR400 crore asset-light Bangalore project was added during the quarter.
demand_pricing: Management described the sector as seasonally softer in Q1 with sequential moderation in presales and collections after a strong Q4 FY26, but attributes this to seasonality rather than a structural slowdown.
Demand is strongest in lifestyle and premium segments; Wadala commercial demand is linked to the new airport and BKC connectivity and GCC growth.
Ajmera One (Versova) demand is for larger apartments; management expects subdued sales this year until superstructure progresses.
Mid and luxury segments are seeing an uptick per management, though overall sales were subdued due to fewer large launches this quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Status of Kanjurmarg land conversion and tie-up for the 7-acre plot?
qa_highlights.answer: Conversion targeted in 2-3 months, before the December deadline; tie-up talks are active but will only conclude after conversion. Deal is a single transaction, with a mix of outright and JV bids.

qa_highlights.question: Confidence in the INR3,600 crore single-phase Wadala boutique office launch and why it was scaled up?
qa_highlights.answer: Approval changes added ~1 million sq ft FSI and ~INR3,000 crores GDV. Office launch scaled from 4-5 lakh sq ft to 8-8.5 lakh sq ft, supported by GCC and connectivity-driven demand.

qa_highlights.question: Why have Pune and Borivali launch timelines moved?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly regulatory reasons; management is choosing to launch at plinth level for better demand and pricing, not at excavation stage.

qa_highlights.question: Why are sales weak at Ajmera One (Versova)?
qa_highlights.answer: Demand for larger units appears only after RCC level; the project is at excavation, so management will not push desperate sales and expects a year before traction.

qa_highlights.question: Why did consolidated finance cost rise from ~INR21 crores to ~INR30 crores QoQ?
qa_highlights.answer: Solis entered revenue recognition, so accumulated interest on its high-cost PE-funded debt was charged to P&L. Cost is expected to normalise to about INR20 crores from next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Was there any P&L impact from the INR89 crores monetisation, and why was SV Concrete dropped?
qa_highlights.answer: The INR89 crores is a balance-sheet financial asset realisation with no P&L impact. SV Concrete was swapped for Whitefield (INR389 crores GDV, Q4 FY27 target).

risks_watch: Debt-equity may stay above 0.47x for a quarter or two due to pre-RERA working capital needs before reaching the 1x target.
Kanjurmarg conversion timing (December deadline) and the strategic tie-up structure are unresolved.
Large Wadala boutique office launch (~INR3,600 crores single phase) is unprecedented for the company and depends on commercial demand.
Launch slippage: Pune and Borivali were moved to Q4 FY27; Ajmera One sales are subdued until superstructure starts.
Weighted average cost of debt and finance cost normalisation to ~INR20 crores per quarter needs to be confirmed in Q2.

summary.management_tone: Management was confident on demand and the Wadala launch and on Kanjurmarg conversion timing, but guarded on near-term sales, saying Q1 and Q2 may see higher working-capital borrowing before deleveraging. It was evasive on the reason for the SV Concrete drop and gave no firm timeline for the Ajmera One (Versova) sales recovery.

growth.why: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 23% YoY to about INR320 crores, but sales value of INR146 crores was subdued and launches slipped (Pune and Borivali to Q4 FY27), with Wadala office targeted for Q3 and the INR3,000 crore FY27 launch pipeline now the main growth support.
